_comment: Tier-2 for sparta chemistry: 'react <style> <file>' never validates the file type. ReactBird consumes data lines in PAIRS, so a file with an ODD number of data lines (ar.vss, a one-line junk file) is accepted in silence with zero reactions, while an EVEN-line junk file aborts with 'Invalid reaction formula in file'. The only count is the '#-of-reactions' line under 'Gas reaction tallies:', and it counts entries PARSED — declaring only 2 of the 5 species leaves it at 45 while no reaction can fire. 'react qk' on a tce file is accepted without complaint.
